svg.text: PR #1883 · Hoist portal_reminder + heartbeat_watchdog into session-lib
Two agent-agnostic proxy-session modules lived inside claude-session-lib where nothing marked
them shared; they move to session_lib::proxy_session, and a hidden claude coupling surfaced.

g.text: claude-session-lib::proxy_session
portal_reminder · heartbeat_watchdog · ConnectionResult ·
SharedWsWrite / WsRead — machinery for EVERY proxied agent
nothing in the module path says which parts serve which agents —
"does this work for muse?" means tracing launcher construction sites
and the caveat proved itself
fold_session_start_reminder had zero claude_codes imports, yet
defaulted its display event via claude_user_echo_value
exactly the hidden claude-shape the tracker warned the heuristic misses
tracker #1657, before this PR
1 of 5 slices done (git metadata, #1653); five modules waiting
agent coverage unknowable by reading — the cost that motivated the issue
session_lib::proxy_session — the landing zone
portal_reminder + portal_reminder.md · heartbeat_watchdog ·
ConnectionResult · NativeConnection · SharedWsWrite · WsRead
claude-session-lib re-exports everything — internal call sites and the
proxy crate's wholesale re-export keep their existing paths
the coupling is inverted, not relocated
fold_session_start_reminder takes a caller-supplied display closure;
input_delivery and wiggum pass claude's echo synthesizer
behavior identical; a codex/muse caller now supplies its own echo shape

svg.text: full launcher build — Session stays Sync
